values.goal: Use the Composition API to distinguish state, derived values, and side effects, and manage the lifetimes of notes and Canvas.
values.capstone: A Vue workspace with per-unit notes and Canvas, a props/emits contract table, a React lifetime comparison, and resource audit records.

values.title: Reactivity and Templates
values.prerequisites: JavaScript objects, arrays, and functions; HTML forms; running an npm project.
values.environment: Use .vue SFCs and script setup in a separate Vue Vite project. Record package versions and the lockfile, and run on the development server. Implement the extended deliverables described here in a separate project.
values.concepts.0.title: ref
values.concepts.0.explanation: ref wraps a reactive value, which you read and write with .value in scripts. Templates automatically unwrap top-level refs for display.
values.concepts.1.title: computed
values.concepts.1.explanation: computed calculates a result from the reactive values it reads. Do not copy values derivable from the source, such as the completed count, into another ref.
